subject: re-st
title: (R)RE.ST.------TRS.
description: Diagram in T(AF)M-17, paired with v1-p113-1 on the same page. (R)RE-ST — the reality of restructuralism — is crossed with TRS (transition). The diagram reads against Braxton's claim that black creativity is 'providing clues as to the next transitional progression (to real transformation)': what does it mean for restructuralism's *reality* (not its concept) to be crossed with transition? RE-ST is fed by TR-INFO (trans-information) → SOC-RT-DY (social reality dynamics), and by DYM-SPT (dynamic spiritualism). RE-ST then outputs to TRS, which solid-branches to LK-IMP (linkage implications), MT-INFO (music information), and ACC-FT (accelerated functionalism). A separate output from RE-ST runs to C-CULT-AT (composite culture attitude) → PART (participation) and → AFI (affinity insight). The structural argument: real restructuralism (not abstract restructuring) requires *both* trans-information feeding through social reality dynamics *and* dynamic spiritualism as upstream inputs. Once activated, it produces transition that fans into linkage implications, music information, and accelerated functionalism — and a parallel composite-culture-attitude chain that produces participation and affinity insight. The diagram thus stages what trans-African creativity's projected role in transformation would structurally require.
